tool: gpt-image 스킬(Codex 내장 image_gen, ChatGPT 구독 인증)
prompt:
Product reference photo of the outside face of a single-leaf steel door on an illegal light-steel rooftop add-on of an aging 1990s Korean villa, a door that has stood exposed to rain and sun for years. The leaf is about 90 cm wide, 205 cm high and 4.5 cm thick, flush pressed steel with no window, painted a faded dark grey-green semi-gloss enamel, the paint sun-bleached and chalky toward the top and marked with faint grey rain runs coming down from the top edge. On this face: near the right edge at 95 cm height a plain satin steel lever handle on a tall narrow rectangular escutcheon plate, with a round key cylinder in the plate below the lever; at eye height in the middle of the leaf, a small clean-edged rectangle of less faded paint where a small unit-number plate was unscrewed and taken away, with two empty screw holes and a little dried adhesive residue, nothing written there. Wear: rust bloom along the bottom edge and lower corners, scratches around the keyhole, a darker hand band at shoulder height near the lever edge. The hinges are on the other face and are not visible. The door is shown alone, closed and standing upright, seen from a gentle three-quarter angle. No frame, no wall, no floor.
Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, lighting variation, or scenery.
Constraints: do not use #00ff00 or any green reflected spill anywhere on the subject; crisp silhouette suitable for chroma removal; generous green padding around the silhouette; no part of the subject cut off by the frame edge; no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no border, no cast shadow on the green background.
Rendering discipline (critical): resolve every surface with gentle continuous gradients, never with fine dots. Absolutely no per-pixel noise of any kind: no stippling, no dithering, no halftone or screen-door pattern, no pointillist speckle, no sand or dust overlay, no crosshatch, no chromatic speckle, no oversharpened edge halos, no JPEG mosquito artifacts, no added film grain. Prefer slightly soft over crunchy; if uncertain, make it smoother. Restrained detail that still reads at 512 px. Soft neutral light on the subject only, no rim light, no bloom, no colour grading, no depth of field, no motion blur, no baked contact shadow.
usage: 5층 철문(SM_AnnexDoorLeaf)의 옥상 쪽 면 기준. 비에 바랜 위쪽, 빗물 자국, 호수 표찰을 떼어 낸 자리의 나사 구멍 둘과 접착 자국, 손잡이 위 손때, 아래쪽 녹.
